concept:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game art and combat animation design presentation for Garden Guard / 花园防线. Create a new ICE STAR botanical defense tower design sheet by transforming the seed-cannon concept presentation into its companion tower. Reference image 1 is the existing presentation's art direction and layout ONLY. Reference image 2 is the actual shipped seed cannon sprite style ONLY. Replace the seed cannon subjects and all seed-specific assets with ORIGINAL ice-star artwork; do not just recolor a gun. Match the same thick dark-teal hand-drawn outlines, plump candy-like botanical forms, clean cel-painted soft highlights, readable small silhouettes and gentle contact shadows. This is a top-down 2D sprite game, not realistic 3D, not a mechanical turret.
Layout: landscape 1536x1024 polished pale mint/cream design board, same coherent spacious botanical presentation style. Exact headline text: "冰冻星". Subtitle: "ICE STAR · COMBAT REDESIGN". Top left: large hero view of tower plus magnified snowball. Top right: three clear upgrade variants labeled "Lv.1", "Lv.2", "Lv.3". Middle: 4-frame attack strip with labels "蓄冷 100ms", "弹射 60ms", "回弹 100ms", "复位 160ms". Bottom left: small IN-GAME STYLE MOCKUP on the existing light grass tiles and warm cream path, tower launching a snowball toward one rounded green block enemy; sharp ice-chip impact on enemy's near side, translucent shallow frosted ground patch under its feet, enemy stays visible. Label this panel exactly "战场效果示意". Bottom right: detached effect breakdown panels "雪球与霜迹", "接触闪光", "冰晶碎片", "冰面扩散".
Tower design: soft chunky FIVE-point star made of pale turquoise ice petals, dark teal outline, a tiny amber-gold round seed/dewdrop core at center, two stubby mint-green leaves supporting back/bottom. Fixed near-top-down view with a little thickness on lower edges, upright in all samples; one star tip points to the right as the firing direction. NO face, NO eyes, NO cannon barrel or bottle silhouette, NO pedestal or industrial hardware. Lv.1 plain frosty star with simple seed core and two short leaves; Lv.2 same footprint plus milk-white frosting on tips and two small blue ice buds on leaf base; Lv.3 a slightly fuller same five-point silhouette, brighter opaque frosted rim, three clear ice buds, visibly faceted amber core, minimal extra detail. Do not grow footprint more than 15%. Star petals contract toward center during cold charge, right-hand petal flicks outward when emitting snowball, body recoils softly then returns; leaf support remains still.
Snowball: soft WHITE spherical packed-snow pellet with pale blue faceted shadow, deep teal-blue rim around underside, one tiny icy star indentation, has mass and stays visible on green ground. Its trail is short and curved with 3-5 white snow grains and a wispy blue arc, not a laser. Hit: very short crisp white-cyan contact glint, a compact snow burst, 4-6 chunky angular blue/white ice shards + 2 tiny frosted mint leaf chips, then a low-opacity spreading cracked ice patch in the ground plane with a readable icy blue edge. Show independent fragment shapes cleanly; keep bloom restrained, do not obscure enemy or gameplay. Freeze visual language indicates SLOWING, not imprisoning enemy in an ice cube. Ice patch no huge spike forest.
Palette: outline #245E67, ice #9BE5EE, ice shadow #4BAFC6, snow #F8FFFD, mint leaves #7BBC98, core #E9BD63. Clean readable Chinese labels, no unrelated slogans, no watermarks, no huge neon glow, no pixel art. Render a finished cohesive art direction board.
towers:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production TRANSPARENT sprite atlas for the Ice Star tower in Garden Guard. Derive isolated animation sprites from the ice-star tower in the reference concept sheet. The reference is the approved appearance; preserve its soft plump FIVE-petal ice star silhouette, dark teal thick outlines, amber-gold center, mint leaves, top-left soft cel-painted highlights, nearly top-down view and short lower-edge thickness. NO faces, guns, machines or pedestal. Same exact three level variants as reference: Lv1 plain turquoise star, Lv2 milk-white icing on tips and 2 side ice buds, Lv3 heavier frosted petal edges and 3 small side/bottom ice buds. Do not copy text or background.
Create ONE landscape PNG atlas on genuine transparent background, 1536x1024. EXACTLY 15 separate tower sprites, regular 5 columns by 3 rows, no other elements, no text. Each of the 15 sprites is centered within its own equal grid cell. Generous transparent gutters, no overlap, no cropped tips, no connecting lines, no labels, no gridlines, no background/grass/gradient/fog/glow. Only tiny tight soft alpha contact shadows directly under tower permitted. Use same 210x220 approximate footprint for every tower; levels stay same scale, camera fixed, all stars upright and firing tip directed right. Leaf support position and alpha shadow stay identical across each row. Crisp fully opaque main body, alpha only on edges/shadow.
Rows: top=Lv1, middle=Lv2, bottom=Lv3. Columns: 1 IDLE original star; 2 CHARGE star petals pulled inward and body compressed horizontally by 10 percent, core brightens creamy-white while retaining gold border; 3 RELEASE star's right-hand petal stretches outward by 10 percent and opens slightly, core luminous icy-white center; 4 RECOIL body shifts left 10px relative to static mint leaves and right-hand petal retracts, star slightly squashed; 5 RECOVER body rebounds to near original silhouette with small 3percent over-extension, core returns amber. Make these poses visibly different while keeping the same recognizable star. Tower-only atlas: NO snowball, NO release flash, NO snow fragments, NO frost trail, NO ground ice patch; these are separate effect assets. No translucent whole-body wash, no neon bloom, no pixels. Production sprite finish consistent with the actual seed cannon assets shown in reference's companion visual style.
